question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city,
         t.calendar_quarter_desc,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
city_growth AS (
  SELECT q4_2019.cust_city
  FROM city_sales q4_2019
  JOIN city_sales q4_2020 ON q4_2019.cust_city = q4_2020.cust_city
  WHERE q4_2019.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04'
    AND q4_2020.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04'
    AND q4_2019.total_sales > 0
    AND 1.0 * (q4_2020.total_sales - q4_2019.total_sales) / q4_2019.total_sales >= 0.20
),
qualifying_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id,
         t.calendar_quarter_desc,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM city_growth)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_totals AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         SUM(product_sales) as total_sales_overall
  FROM qualifying_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as num_products
FROM product_totals
